Fully automatic farming robot

a farming revolution

FarmDroid FD20 is a solar-powered field robot that seeds and weeds. By using high-precision RTK GPS, the FarmDroid FD20 marks the position of each plant at seeding and subsequently performs both inter-row weeding between rows and intra-row weeding between plants.

Our FarmDroid FD20 platform offers an all-in-one solution that handles everything in plant production from harvest to harvest. Check out some of the features below:

  • High precision seeding

    Our unique +Seed system ensures precise seed placement in the field. A 3D-printed seed disc accurately meters the specified number of seeds and the robot places them in the soil with 8mm GPS precision. The seed unit also detects potential issues, such as an empty container or dirt in the system, and automatically notifies the farmer, ensuring a smooth and reliable seeding process.

  • Inter and intrarow weeding

    Our +Weed system mechanically removes weeds in between rows and plants. As FarmDroid does not rely on camera systems and works with GPS coordinates, it can start weeding even before the plants germinate!

  • Targeted micro-spraying

    Our robot equipped with +Spray system micro-sprays plant protection substances where needed. This targeted approach reduces the use of chemicals by up to 94%, benefiting the environment and reducing operational costs at the same time. Depending on specific farm’s needs, our farm robot can be configured for spot or band spraying.

  • Co2 neutral operation

    With four solar panels, FarmDroid FD20 efficiently converts sunlight into power for its two batteries, providing a maximum output of 1.6 kWh. Depending on weather conditions and operational demands, this energy storage enables 18–24 hours of continuous field work. Running at a steady pace of 950 metres per hour, the FD20 covers up to 6 hectares in a day.

  • Compatible with 100+ crop types

    Although FarmDroid’s journey began with a primary focus on sugar beets, today, our farm robot confidently ensures precision in seeding and weeding of more than 100 crops including spinach, chicory, onion, cabbage, and more.

  • Scaleable with more robots

    We suggest the FD20 for fields between 20 and 30 hectares, depending on the crops grown. Got bigger areas than one FarmDroid can handle? No worries. Our robots can run as a fleet! Fields can be transferred between each robot so one robot could be seeding while the other is weeding. Contact us to find out how many FarmDroids you might need for your crops and field size.

  • Preserve soil structure and fertility

    When large agricultural machines traverse the soil, they exert immense pressure, significantly compromising its fertility. Our lightweight farm robot, weighing only 1250 kg with standard features, safeguards the delicate soil structure, thus preserving soil fertility.

  • Get started quickly and easily

    When you reach out to us, our agricultural robotics experts will guide you through configuring your FarmDroid to best suit your crops and field needs. Along with our local distributors, we will support you throughout the entire process, ensuring a smooth experience from start to finish.

  • Guided setup and convenient operations all season

    Enjoy the guided setup process through our FarmDroid app and the convenience of reliable field assistant, working tirelessly in the field all season. With our Field Setup Tool it makes it even easier to map out your field and have your FarmDroid running in no time.

One farming robot multiple functions

Integrated Seeding and Weed Control

Did you know FarmDroid is a farming robot with three valuable functions? The robot automatically seeds with precision, effectively removes weeds using mechanical tools, and spot-sprays plant protection substances. All to lower costs, increase efficiency and reduce the use of chemicals.

Whats in it for you

Make your farming sustainable

The FarmDroid FD20 empowers you to improve plant growth effortlessly. No need to invest in separate seeding systems, mechanical weeding tools, or organize manual labor. The FD20 handles it all while being CO₂-efficient and sustainable. Its solar-powered and lightweight design reduces fuel costs and prevents soil compaction, unlike heavier machinery. As the perfect field keeper, the FarmDroid FD20 lets you focus on other farm tasks while ensuring optimal crop care—from seeding to harvest.

Contact us for a price

Why not let a farming robot do the heavy lifting?

We know how hard work farming is

Especially in ecological agriculture, weeding is often a labor-intensive and costly manual task. High labor costs per hectare, exhausting work, and a general shortage of farm labor make it challenging for farmers to grow economically sustainable crops. This challenge inspired our founders to develop a robot that could automate weed control in farming. Today, it’s not just ecological farmers—conventional farmers looking to reduce chemical use are also choosing our autonomous farming robot.

How it works

With FarmDroid FD20, sowing and weeding are fully automated—both between rows and between plants. Since the robot sows the crops itself, it knows the exact position of every seed and, therefore, precisely where to clean—and, more importantly, where not to clean!
With our latest innovation, FarmDroid can now also micro-spray liquid plant protection precisely where it’s needed, reducing chemical use by up to 94%.

FarmDroid FD20 operates completely on its own without the need for constant monitoring. In case of any deviations, the robot stops by itself and notifies the farmer, ensuring that fieldwork is done correctly.
